newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle rises ahead of final results.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle rises ahead of final results.

text.p: Shares of Great Eagle Holdings Ltd rose on Wednesday on anticipation of strong earnings growth ahead of the release of its final results, brokers said.

"I expect around 20 percent growth (in earnings) on the back of some exceptional items and also from rising rental income and an increasing contribution from hotel projects," said Ben Kwong, director of research at Dharmala Securities.
Great Eagle shares were up HK$1.10 or 3.32 percent to HK$34.20 just before the midday break on volume of 873,577 shares.
A consensus of analysts' forecasts showed expectations of a 23 percent rise in Great Eagle's year-end profit to HK$1.01 billion for the year ended September 30.
The company is due to release its final results later on Wednesday.
Brokers said expectations that the company's future earnings would benefit from a possible spinoff of its office and commercial properties also aided buying.
In August, Great Eagle said it was considering a separate listing of shares of a new holding company containing its office and commercial property interests.
